title: GODAI
tagline: A Japanese-mythology metroidvania made by a team for my master's final project, where I was Lead Programmer.
overview: A 2D metroidvania inspired by Hollow Knight, Blasphemous, Metroid and Castlevania. You play Hinata, a warrior who must free the gods trapped by the Oni King, Shuten Doji, using the powers of the four **Godai elements**: fire, water, air and earth.
As **Lead Programmer** I led the programming team, defined the technical approach and built the core gameplay systems.

highlights.title: Elemental powers
highlights.text: Fire, water, air and earth to solve challenges and defeat enemies.

highlights.title: Interconnected world
highlights.text: Regions linked together, with puzzles, secrets and increasingly dangerous enemies.

highlights.title: Multi-phase final boss
highlights.text: Seiryu, with phased behavior and attack logic.

contributions: **Player controller**: movement physics, combat and ability management.
**Health system**: damage logic based on hitboxes and hurtboxes.
**Dialogue system** built with [Ink](https://www.inklestudios.com/ink/), with variable storage and function calls.
**Save system** with JSON serialization, and a **scene loader** with dependency management.
**Events and global variables** with ScriptableObjects, based on my own open-source tools: [SO Game Events](#so-game-events) and [Unity Global Variables](#global-variables).
**UI**: HUD, main and pause menus, loading screens and dialogue interface.
Collectibles, environment interaction and the final boss.
learnings: Leading a programming team and coordinating technical decisions.
Working closely with designers and artists so their work integrates smoothly.
Building complex gameplay systems for a metroidvania and optimizing them.
